records.name: Male-01
records.prompt: Repair the animation in the reference sheet, preserving EXACT SAME character identity, outfit, hair, slender proportions, palette and clean pixel-art style. Create an EIGHT-PHASE rightward WALK cycle, NOT four phases repeated. ALL EIGHT characters face RIGHT in strict profile, head and torso fixed in identical orientation. Square transparent canvas with4 columns2rows, ample transparent gutters, complete uncut figures. Reading top row left to right then bottom row: (1) NEAR leg extended forward heel strike / FAR leg extended backward toe; (2) NEAR knee bends under weight, FAR foot lifts behind; (3) NEAR leg planted straight under hip, FAR knee passes forward bent; (4) NEAR heel lifts, FAR leg reaches forward; (5) FAR leg forward heel strike / NEAR leg backward toe, opposite arms to frame1; (6) FAR knee under weight, NEAR foot lifts behind; (7) FAR leg planted under hip, NEAR knee passes forward bent; (8) FAR heel lifts, NEAR leg reaches forward. Near/far legs and arms MUST be visibly distinguishable through original dark far-limb shading and arm overlaps, so frame5 is not identical to1 and frame6 not2. Eight UNIQUE sequential poses, no duplicates, no idle stance, no direction turning. Opposite arm swing, gentle down/up body bob, natural motion. Same body scale/feet baseline within each evenly spaced cell. No new accessories, no redesign, no extra textures outside silhouette, no detached pixel flecks, no text/grid/shadows/background gradient. Actual transparent background.
